threads.title: WeightTraining #158
threads.preview:
That is what I want to hear. Lock it in.

Quick checklist before you touch a bar

paragraphs: Look, you said you were going to get back on the board with a lift, and you got 23 minutes in yesterday morning. It breaks the dry spell. Let me know what you actually hit in that session, what the RPE was, and if we're still locking in another lift this weekend.

messages.text: That was just morning foundation coach

paragraphs: Got it. So that was foundation, not the lift. Which means the dry spell is still live, Sky. You committed to getting one real lift in this weekend before the travel window hits next week. Are we locking in Workout A today or tomorrow?

messages.text: I will do it today coach!

paragraphs:
That is what I want to hear. Lock it in.

Quick checklist before you touch a bar:
1. Single-leg glute bridge on the right in the warm-up. Squeeze before extending.
2. Front lever protocol: SL FL benchmark tested LEFT first, then straddle negatives (25kg band, 5x3 controlled), then SL holds (15kg band, 3x10s).
3. Dips stay at bodyweight with that 3-second eccentric.

Keep it clean, get your numbers down, and tell me how it felt when you're done.

messages.text: My right shoulder has been bugging me all week, feels tight during overhead movement.

paragraphs: Look, when a shoulder talks to you on overhead movement, we listen. For now, overhead pressing is off the table. We keep the pulling and sub pressing for band work. How does it feel hanging or doing light arm circles right now?

messages.text: Also my left knee's been a bit sore the last few days.

paragraphs: Look, when joints start chiming in together, we don't ignore it. I've logged the left knee soreness alongside the shoulder. We'll pull back on deep loaded knee flexion and high impact until it settles. Is it sharp or an ache, and does it bite on stairs or squats?

messages.text: Good news - the knee one is totally fine now, no soreness at all the last two days. The shoulder's still bothering me though.

paragraphs: Look, that's one less fire to put out. Left knee is cleared, so we don't have to baby your lower body. But with that shoulder still talking, overhead pressing stays locked out. Keep the pulling honest and sub in band work. Are you feeling it on daily stuff or just when reaching up?

input.message: That's it for today, wrap this up.

output.reply: Look, that's a wrap. We've got the shoulder flagged and pressing off the table, and the knee is in the clear. Rest up, take care of that shoulder, and we'll get right back to the work tomorrow. Catch you then.
